rows.source_ref_name: Dye Trader during a Blood Moon for
rows.notes: Bloodbath Dye is a dye purchased from the Dye Trader during a Blood Moon for 7 GC 50 SC . When applied, it gives the item an appearance similar to dripping blood.

rows.source_ref_name: Zoologist during a Hardmode Blood Moon for
rows.notes: The Full Moon Squeaky Toy is a Hardmode pet-summoning item that spawns a Baby Werewolf that follows the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, the Baby Werewolf flies after them by flapping its arms, mimicking a bird-like creature. The Full Moon Squeaky Toy can be purchased from the Zoologist during a Hardmode Blood Moon for 30 GC .

rows.source_ref_name: Clothier during a Blood Moon for
rows.notes: The Mime Mask is a vanity item equipped in the Social Helmet slot. It is purchased from the Clothier during a Blood Moon for 2 GC .

The Rainbow Glowstick is a consumable light source . It behaves similarly to the regular Bouncy Glowstick when thrown, but cycles its light through the rainbow, as well as leaving behind a trail. It can be purchased from the Merchant during a Party for 20 CC each and can also be obtained from Chests in Celebration Mk 10 or Rainbow road worlds. In those worlds, Rainbow Glowsticks replace Glowsticks in Chests, in the same quantity. [ 1 ]

rows.source_ref_name: Merchant during a Blood Moon for
rows.notes: The Throwing Knife is a consumable ranged weapon . It can hit up to 2 targets. It can be purchased from the Merchant during a Blood Moon for 50 CC each and may also be found in Chests . The Throwing Knife is greatly affected by gravity and arcs similarly to Shurikens and Bones . It has the greatest range out of these consumable ranged weapons (with Bones having the least).

rows.source_ref_name: Skeleton Merchant during certain moon phases for
rows.notes: The Strange Brew is a pre-Hardmode recovery potion that can be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant during certain moon phases for 5 SC . When used, it restores 70–120 health , inflicts 40–70 seconds of Potion Sickness , and has a 3/5 (60%) chance to grant up to 4 seconds of invincibility . The duration of Potion Sickness can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths .

rows.source_ref_name: Party Girl during a Party for
rows.notes: The Pigronata is a placeable furniture item hung by the player from the underside of blocks , similar to banners . When hit with weapons or projectiles , it is destroyed in a shower of confetti, and drops coins and/or other loot. Pigronatas can be purchased from the Party Girl during a Party for 1 GC each.

rows.source_ref_name: Party Girl during a Party for
rows.notes: The Party Present is a decorative furniture item that can be purchased from the Party Girl during a Party for 20 SC . It has one of several different appearances when placed, similar to Books .
The Wizard's Hat is a Hardmode vanity item purchased from the Wizard during Halloween for 3 GC .

rows.source_ref_name: Skeleton Merchant during a Waxing Gibbous for
rows.notes: The Radar has a 1/10 (10%) chance of being obtained from looting regular Chests found on or near the surface, or a 1/100 (1%) chance from Wooden and Pearlwood Crates obtained via fishing . The Radar can also be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant during a Waxing Gibbous for 2 GC 50 SC .
The Guy Fawkes Mask is a head piece vanity item . It is purchased from the Clothier during Halloween for 3 GC .

The Disco Ball is a novelty Hardmode light source that can be placed on the underside of blocks , generating short pulses of colored light that cycle through the spectrum (In the Nintendo 3DS version , the Disco Ball will cycle through red, green, and blue only). The light can be toggled with wires . It is purchased from the Merchant in Hardmode for 1 GC each.

rows.source_ref_name: Dye Trader while in a Graveyard
rows.notes: Fogbound Dye is a dye purchased from the Dye Trader while in a Graveyard (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) for 7 GC 50 SC . When equipped, it reduces the color saturation of the item and gives it a grayer tone, with a fog-like effect overlaying on top of the item.

rows.source_ref_name: Merchant when he is in the Jungle biome for
rows.notes: (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) The Furnace can also be purchased from the Merchant when he is in the Jungle biome for 3 SC .
Hallowed Seeds are Hardmode seeds used to plant Hallowed grass on Dirt Blocks , which will then spread The Hallow . Hallowed Seeds are purchased from the Dryad in Hardmode for 20 SC each.
Jellyfish Blocks are Hardmode blocks purchased from the Pirate in a Graveyard for 50 CC each. Their main use is crafting Jellyfish furniture and Jellyfish Walls . They glow in the dark when placed.

It cannot be obtained in a Crimson world unless the player makes an artificial Corruption biome (e.g. using Corrupt Seeds , purchased from the Dryad in a Graveyard (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) ) or uses a Corrupt Statue .

rows.source_ref_name: Clothier while in a Graveyard for
rows.notes: The Pretty Mirror is a consumable weapon that can be thrown at targets. The damage it deals is not classified as any of the four damage types and therefore cannot be modified by any buffs or equipment. The Pretty Mirror can be purchased from the Clothier while in a Graveyard for 1 GC . Upon breaking, the Pretty Mirror decreases luck by 0.25 for 7 minutes to all players within a 19.875×19.875-tile rectangular area centered on the point of impact. [ 1 ]

Team Dye is a dye that can be purchased from the Dye Trader while playing Multiplayer . The color of this dye will correspond to the team the player is on; if the player is not on a team, it acts as though no dye was equipped.

In addition to being crafted, Unholy Arrows are dropped by the Eye of Cthulhu . Furthermore, they can be purchased from the Arms Dealer at night for 40 CC once the Eater of Worlds or Brain of Cthulhu has been defeated. During Hardmode , they become available during the day as well.
